sections.bio:
Business student with experience across venture development, B2B sales, and AI-driven digital transformation in startup and corporate environments. 
Currently working at Wayra Germany. Meanwhile also supporting sales execution at an AI startup and advising companies as a student consultant with a focus on ai transformation. 
Passionate about creating a strong network of ambitious women around me through femella, an international female community.

posts.text:
The best cold call I ever made wasn't cold at all.

I knew the prospect had just raised a Series A, hired 3 SDRs, and engaged with two competitor posts that week.
That's not luck. That's timing.

"That's not a priority right now."
I heard that 50 times a day. Not because my pitch was bad.
Because I was calling blind.

So I built a system that detects buying signals before I pick up the phone.
It runs while I sleep:

❓Who's engaging with competitor content right now?
❓Who just changed roles or scaled their team?
❓Which companies just closed a funding round?

Those aren't just leads. Those are people with a problem, a budget, and a reason to move.

I stopped creating context. I started calling inside an existing one.
More qualified demos. Better conversations. Zero cold starts.

If you're still dialing blind, you're not losing on volume.
You're losing on timing.

When you think about entrepreneurship — do you automatically think about men?
That’s exactly what we want to change with the Female Entrepreneurship Summit. The Energy on saturday was something rare. A room full of ambitious and driven Women.✨
A huge thank you to everyone who helped bring this event to life: femella, Young Founders Network e.V., SheLeads . and WIB – Women in Business e.V. 
If you‘re also a young woman currently building her business or just building her life, let‘s chat!👇

 #FemaleEntrepreneurship #FemaleEntrepreneurshipSummit #femella

If you don’t see enough women at the table — you go where they’re building their own.

This weekend, I’m choosing to surround myself with ambitious women at the Female Entrepreneurship Summit in Munich. 🚀 

Because the reality is: Only 19% of founders in Germany are women, and that’s exactly why spaces like this matter. 

Together with femella, Young Founders Network e.V., WIB – Women in Business e.V., and SheLeads, this event puts inspiring female founders on stage — sharing real insights, journeys, and learnings to make entrepreneurship more accessible and tangible for women. 

If you’re also attending (or just passionate about entrepreneurship) let’s connect. I’m always up for a good conversation ☕
